items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So when Foots called me then about this Cab Calloway, he said it's going to be sensational, you better come on now... I told Foots, well, no, I started with these little boys, but it might work up to something, Walt, and I believe I'll stick with it along with my little job for a while yet.

ctx.x: I'm not trying to imply that he was dishonest, Reg Marshall, but guys did have some things about him.
